classification.difficultyReason: Students identify the reverse direction and link cointerior angles with angles at a point; both north lines and the required bearing arcs are supplied.

spec.description: P lies northwest of Q. Both vertices have vertical north arrows. The given clockwise bearing at P is 140 degrees; the requested clockwise reflex sector at Q is unlabelled.
spec.mathematics: PQ has bearing 140 degrees from P. QP has bearing 320 degrees from Q.
spec.answerVisibility: The given 140-degree angle is visible; the supplied blue answer is excluded.

answer.worked:
The north lines are parallel. Let $x$ be the smaller angle between north and $QP$ at $Q$.
$$\begin{aligned}x&=180^\circ-140^\circ\\&=40^\circ\end{aligned}$$
Cointerior angles sum to $180^\circ$.
$$\begin{aligned}\text{Bearing of }P\text{ from }Q&=360^\circ-40^\circ\\&=320^\circ\end{aligned}$$
